title: Actions related to transmission of the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink by the UE

entities.name: Transmission of UECapabilityEnquirySidelink
entities.description: Procedure for the initiating UE to prepare and transmit the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message to request sidelink capability information from a peer UE.

entities.name: UECapabilityEnquirySidelink
entities.description: Message sent by initiating UE to request sidelink capability information from a peer UE.

entities.name: ue-CapabilityInformationSidelink
entities.description: Information element containing UE radio access capabilities for sidelink communication.

entities.name: frequencyBandListFilterSidelink
entities.description: Information element specifying frequency bands for which the peer UE is requested to provide supported bands and band combinations.

entities.name: UE decision to include ue-CapabilityInformationSidelink
entities.description: Condition where the initiating UE decides whether to include its own sidelink capability information in the message.

entities.name: Mandatory inclusion of frequencyBandListFilterSidelink
entities.description: Condition requiring the initiating UE to always include frequencyBandListFilterSidelink field in the message.

entities.name: Submit message to lower layers
entities.description: Action where the UE submits the prepared UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message to lower layers for transmission.

relations.description: The procedure involves preparing and transmitting the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message.
The message may contain the ue-CapabilityInformationSidelink IE if the UE decides to include it.
The message must contain the frequencyBandListFilterSidelink IE.
Inclusion of ue-CapabilityInformationSidelink is guarded by UE decision condition.
Inclusion of frequencyBandListFilterSidelink is guarded by mandatory condition.
The procedure includes submitting the message to lower layers for transmission.
